✅ **Health Monitoring Design Complete!**

**What the Architect Designed:**

📊 **3 API Endpoints:**
- `/api/chat/health` - Real-time queue & process status
- `/api/chat/status` - Detailed statistics
- `/health` - Quick system check

🎨 **Dashboard at `/chat`:**
- Color-coded status (🟢 Green/🟡 Yellow/🔴 Red)
- Queue stats (pending count, oldest message age)
- Process health (PIDs, uptime)
- Recent activity log
- Auto-refresh every 5 seconds

⚠️ **Smart Alerts:**
- 🟢 GREEN: All healthy
- 🟡 YELLOW: Messages >2min old, 5-10 pending, or 1 process down
- 🔴 RED: Messages >5min old, 10+ pending, or 2+ processes down

**Implementation Starting Now:**
Next, I'm delegating to the coder agent to build the backend endpoints and dashboard UI.

You'll see progress updates as each phase completes!
